steps.text: Create a key and submit with it under its original name
Rename it through POST /api/auth/api-key/update and keep submitting
Settings Usage shows the new name

checks.name: API: first submission creates a Link (202)
API: the update returns the new name
API: the renamed key submits two more Links (202)
API: a Duplicate from it is accepted and not counted
API: Usage lists the key under the new name, active, 3 links
UI: 'API key: <new name>' with 3 and no badge
UI: the old name is nowhere on the page
UI: the API keys list shows the new name
The confirmation names the key by its new name
API: the key is gone and its secret answers 401
API: Usage keeps it under the last name, status deleted, 3 links
UI after reload: 'API key: <new name>' with a Deleted badge and 3
